arguments.sql:
WITH repeated_income_zips AS (
    SELECT i.zipcode
    FROM main.income_trees AS i
    GROUP BY i.zipcode
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
tree_groups AS (
    SELECT t.zipcode, t.boroname, COUNT(*) AS tree_records
    FROM main.trees AS t
    WHERE t.zipcode = 83 OR t.zipcode IN (SELECT r.zipcode FROM repeated_income_zips AS r)
    GROUP BY t.zipcode, t.boroname
)
SELECT g.zipcode, g.boroname, g.tree_records,
       i.Estimate_Total, i.Estimate_Median_income, i.Estimate_Mean_income
FROM tree_groups AS g
LEFT JOIN main.income_trees AS i ON i.zipcode = g.zipcode
ORDER BY g.zipcode, g.boroname, i.Estimate_Total

arguments.sql:
WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(t.zipcode, i.zipcode) AS zipcode,
        t.boroname,
        i.Estimate_Median_income,
        i.Estimate_Mean_income
    FROM main.trees AS t
    FULL OUTER JOIN main.income_trees AS i
        ON t.zipcode = i.zipcode
)
SELECT
    boroname,
    COUNT(*) AS tree_count,
    AVG(Estimate_Mean_income) AS average_mean_income
FROM combined
WHERE Estimate_Median_income > 0
  AND Estimate_Mean_income > 0
  AND boroname IN ('Bronx', 'Brooklyn', 'Manhattan', 'Queens', 'Staten Island')
GROUP BY boroname
ORDER BY tree_count DESC, boroname
LIMIT 3
